fusions.name: Closing Jaw
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more for each one. It then leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lunge from Still Water
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 6 tiles away for 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, always as a critical hit. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Sunken Nest
fusions.desc: Sinks a nest at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first 3 enemies to come within 2 tiles take 18 damage.

fusions.name: Scent of the Stung
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
